name: nepal_pre_1986

This fixture is a synthetic probe, not a real birth, so no hand-cast kundali exists for it or can; what it asserts is Asia/Kathmandu at +5:30:00, and that is what was independently confirmed. Planetary longitudes are not independently confirmed here — they rest on test_invariants.py and the hand-cast graha sphuta table in test_textbook.py. Re-frozen unchanged at engine 0.6.1: the Moon epicycle correction is inside Surya Siddhanta and this fixture is drik, so every value here is byte-identical to 0.6.0 and only the version stamp moved.
why: Kathmandu was +5:30 before 1986, not +5:45. A stored offset is 15 min wrong here — about 3.75 deg of ascendant motion.
